character.description: The same young adult male anime protagonist: platinum-blonde hair in a neat long braid, ice-blue eyes, a composed expression and strong brows; a thoughtful everyday traveler with a keen eye for small moments, wearing a recognizable contemporary outfit with a signature jacket, simple accessories, and comfortable shoes with soft lavender accents. Keep this exact face, hair, eyes, body proportions, and signature outfit in every scene.
consistency_rules: Use this exact protagonist identity in every scene; do not redesign, replace, or randomly reinterpret the character.
Preserve the same face, hairstyle, hair color, eye color, age impression, and body proportions.
Keep the signature outfit silhouette, defining accessories, and main color accents consistent across the entire music video.
Do not introduce another protagonist unless the lyrics or scene explicitly require one.

visual_language.action_style: expressive, readable full-body gestures; natural movement; clear pose silhouettes; avoid static repeated poses
visual_language.environment_style: rich anime background design rooted in rainy alley, quiet bus stop, window overlooking the city; preserve the theme's distinctive world and recognizable environmental details
visual_language.lighting_style: cinematic lighting harmonized with rain blue, slate gray, soft lavender, warm amber; coherent light direction, atmospheric depth, and controlled highlights
visual_language.composition_style: varied cinematic framing informed by close-up raindrops, street-level reflection shot, slow-motion umbrella shot; clear subject separation and intentional negative space

camera_guidance.principle: vary shot scale and viewpoint to support the scene; avoid repeating identical framing in consecutive scenes
